canonicalHost.description: Redirect the other host variant to www or to the bare domain.

defaultCode.description: Status code for lines without one. Default 301.

domain.description: Apex domain for host rules, e.g. example.com.

forceHttps.description: Add an HTTP to HTTPS redirect (Apache, nginx).

keepQuery.description: Keep the incoming query string. Default true.

rules.description: One redirect per line: '/old /new', '/old /new 302' or '/blog/* /news/:splat'. Destinations may be absolute URLs.

name: redirect_rules
title: Redirect rules generator
